subject: Invite-only summer roundtable — venue & catering / NDA for guest lists
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Invite-only summer roundtable — venue & catering / NDA for guest lists

Hi Elena,

Hope you’re well — we're planning a small, invite-only executive roundtable for customers and strategic partners on Tue, 14 Sep. Rough parameters: 6-8 Redwoods + ~12 external guests (cap ~20), 2-hour seated dinner with short remarks. Can Summit Venues accommodate a private dining space on that date (evening slot)? If so, can you send:

- Available private rooms (capacity / floor plan)
- Basic venue quote (room rental, minimum spend, AV add-ons)
- Sample menus or a menu CSV we can share with catering ops
- Any NDA or guest-list handling requirements for us to send names (security/compliance asks)

Budget target per-guest: $250–$350 all-in. Also attaching our draft venue contract and a template NDA for guest lists (attached). Please flag any redlines we should expect on your standard contract.

Goal is to lock venue + menu by 7 Aug and have NDAs executed before we circulate guest names. Copying Laura and Ben for logistics and budget.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nda_guestlist_template.docx, venue_contract_draft_v2.pdf
From: Elena Martinez <elena@summitvenues.co>

Subject: Re: Invite-only summer roundtable — venue & catering / NDA for guest lists

Hi Jonas — thanks for reaching out. 14 Sep is available in our Oak Room (private dining, up to 22 seated). High-level info below and I attached a sample venue_quote.pdf:

- Oak Room rental: $1,200 (includes basic AV)
- Food & beverage minimum: $3,500 (can be met with plated 3-course menu at ~$200/guest)
- AV upgrade (lapel mic + playlist): $250 flat
- Security/guest handling: we can host a password-protected guest list and sign a standard event NDA; we prefer the host to initiate NDA so we can limit scanning/photography on premises.

Menu options attached (we can produce a CSV for Chef's Table if helpful). Note: we need final menu 14 days prior for kitchen planning.

I reviewed your draft venue contract — there are two items we typically request to change: limitation of liability cap (we prefer to keep as mutual) and a 7-day final guest list cutoff. I'll mark our redlines and return a countersigned copy by end of week.

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call tomorrow to walk through space and access/loading dock for catering deliveries.

Best,
Elena Martinez
Senior Events Manager
Summit Venues
